title: Smoother play
changes: The game runs smoother: only the scenery around you is drawn and updated, and the hotbar, damage numbers and spell effects do far less work every frame.
Fix: when the server was busy, heroes could show wrong or stuck positions and health until you reconnected. Updates now always arrive intact.
The server no longer spends time on monsters that no hero is near, so a quiet world costs about half as much.
Curious how it runs for you? Add ?perf=1 to the game's address for a small performance readout with a Copy button.
